info.title: CabalSpy API
info.description:
REST API for CabalSpy on-chain labeled wallet data: tracked KOL, Smart Money and Whale wallets on Solana, BNB Chain, Base, Ethereum and Robinhood Chain (blockchain values: solana, bnb, base, eth, rh), with wallet profiles, leaderboards, PnL, token holders and transactions, bundle detection (Solana only), live signals and analytics.

Wallet type availability per chain: Solana has kol, smart, whale. BNB, Base and Robinhood Chain have kol, smart. ETH has kol.

Authentication: every request needs an API key, passed either as the api_key query parameter or as an Authorization Bearer header (the two are equivalent). Get a free key at https://apidashboard.cabalspy.xyz/.

Credits: a REST request costs 10 credits on every plan. The free tier includes 10,000 credits per month; credits reset on the first of every month.

Rate limits: requests per second by plan are 5 (Free), 20 (Starter), 50 (Pro) and 100 (Business). Exceeding the limit returns 429 rate_limited; wait and retry.

Responses share an envelope: success, data, meta (request_id, cached, cache_age_seconds, version, timestamp) and, on some endpoints, pagination.

Real-time data is available separately over WebSocket at wss://stream.cabalspy.xyz (not described by this document; 1 credit per event received).

get.description: Return every wallet CabalSpy tracks for a given chain and wallet type, with public profile (name, avatar, socials, copytrade link). Without a limit all wallets are returned in one response; addresses are sorted alphabetically. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain of the wallets. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Wallet category kol, smart or whale. Availability per chain. Solana has kol, smart, whale. BNB, Base and Robinhood Chain have kol, smart. ETH has kol.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of wallets per page. Omit to return all wallets in one response.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for the next page, the pagination.next_cursor value from the previous response. Empty means from the start.

currency.description: Native currency of the chain (SOL, BNB, ETH).

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page (null means end).

get.description: Check whether CabalSpy tracks an address across all chains and wallet types and return its profile, chain and category (first match). A wallet that is not tracked is not an error: the response is 200 with found false. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The wallet address to look up. Searched across every tracked chain and wallet type.

found.description: Whether the address is tracked by CabalSpy. When false, only found and wallet_address are returned.

type.description: Wallet type where it was found kol, smart or whale.

get.description: Rank tracked wallets by trading volume over a period, each with buy and sell volume, realized PnL, average hold time and win rate. Without a limit the full ranking is returned; page with cursor (a wallet address). Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Wallet category kol, smart or whale. Availability per chain. Solana has kol, smart, whale. BNB, Base and Robinhood Chain have kol, smart. ETH has kol.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Ranking window, one of 6h, 1d, 7d or 30d.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum wallets per page. Omit to return the full ranking.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for the next page, the pagination.next_cursor (a wallet address) from the previous response.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page (null means end).

leaderboard.description: Entries sorted by volume, highest first.

total_volume.description: Buy plus sell volume (native). This is the ranking key.

get.description: Full trading profile for one wallet over a period: period stats, win rate distribution, active and historical tokens, a realized PnL chart and recent trades. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain of the wallet. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The wallet address to profile.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Aggregation window, one of 6h, 1d, 7d or 30d.

active_hours.description: Hours of day when the wallet is most active.

get.description: Current on-chain token balances of a tracked wallet, read live from the chain (no cost basis, no PnL). May briefly return loading true while the balance cache warms up; call again. Returns not_found if the wallet is not tracked. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain of the wallet. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The wallet address whose balances you want.

token_address.description: Token contract or mint address. The native coin uses a pseudo address.

amount.description: Raw balance as a string in the smallest unit.

amount_formatted.description: Human readable balance adjusted for decimals.

last_updated.description: ISO timestamp of the last balance refresh (null if unknown).

stale.description: Whether the cached balance is considered stale.

loading.description: True while the balance cache is still warming up. Call again shortly.

get.description: Day by day realized PnL calendar for a wallet, grouped by month (oldest first), with per day PnL, volume, trade counts and monthly win and loss streaks. Note the path uses singular wallet. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain of the wallet. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The wallet address whose calendar you want.

date.description: Day in the format DD-MM-YY, for example 04-07-26.

dates.description: Convenience copy of the current month dates array (same shape as months dates).

month.description: Convenience copy of the current month summary (same shape as months month).

get.description: Complete lifetime trading history of a wallet: lifetime stats, win rate distribution, a per token overview and a paginated trade log, newest first. Pass pagination.next_cursor back as cursor to fetch the next page. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain of the wallet. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Wallet category kol, smart or whale. Availability per chain. Solana has kol, smart, whale. BNB, Base and Robinhood Chain have kol, smart. ETH has kol.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The wallet address whose history you want.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of trades per page in the trade log.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for the next page of trades, the pagination.next_cursor from the previous response. Empty means from the newest trade.

currency.description: Native currency (may be null on some historical rows).

get.description: Find tracked wallets connected to a given wallet by shared token activity over the last 30 days, sorted by shared_tokens highest first. overlap_score is the share of the source wallet tokens the other wallet also traded, from 0 to 1. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain of the wallet. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The source wallet address to find connections for.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of connections to return. Omit to return all.

wallet_address.description: The source wallet the connections were computed for.

shared_tokens.description: Number of tokens both wallets traded in the last 30 days.

overlap_score.description: Share of the source wallet tokens that the connected wallet also traded, from 0 to 1.

get.description: Aggregate trading statistics for one token across tracked wallets: token block with current market cap, holder totals by wallet type, flow statistics and a per trader breakdown with live position. Market cap, price and live position fields are Solana only (null on other chains). Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain of the token. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: The token mint or contract address.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Optional wallet category to narrow the breakdown kol, smart or whale. Omit to aggregate across all categories available on the chain.

net_flow.description: Buy minus sell (native). Positive means net accumulation.

buying_pressure.description: Buy share of total volume, an indicator of pressure.

traders.description: Traders sorted by buy volume, highest first.

get.description: The tracked wallets holding a token, sorted by amount held highest first, each with profile and live position (bag percentage, unrealized PnL, remaining value, entry market cap). Live position fields are Solana only and null on other chains. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain of the token. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: The token mint or contract address.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Optional wallet category kol, smart or whale. Omit to include all categories.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of holders to return.

holders.description: Holders sorted by amount held, highest first.

get.description: The individual buy and sell transactions of tracked wallets on one token, newest first, each with trader profile and the holder position right after the trade (holdings_after). Current market cap in the token block is Solana only. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain of the token. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: The token mint or contract address.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Optional wallet category kol, smart or whale. Omit to include all categories.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of transactions to return.

get.description: Detect coordinated KOL bundles on a Solana token: the side wallets that bought alongside a KOL in the same block, with confidence score, on chain proof and a live position per wallet. Solana only. If no bundles are detected the response is a normal 200 with an empty bundles array. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Must be solana. Bundle detection is only available on Solana.

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: The token mint address to inspect for bundles.

kol_wallet.description: Address of the KOL at the center of the bundle.

confidence.description: Confidence score that this is a real coordinated bundle.

is_kol.description: True for the KOL wallet, false for side wallets.

profile.description: Wallet profile. For side wallets this may be empty.

fee_lamports.description: Side wallets only. Fee paid in lamports.

block_index.description: Side wallets only. Index within the block.

adjacent_to_kol.description: Side wallets only. Whether the wallet traded directly next to the KOL.

same_fee.description: Side wallets only. Whether the wallet paid the same fee as the KOL.

occurrences.description: Side wallets only. How often this wallet bundled with the KOL.

position.description: Live position, computed at request time.

unrealized_pnl_sol.description: Unrealized PnL on the remaining bag (SOL). Null if market cap is missing.

bundles.verify_hint: check same slot buys on solscan

get.description: The most recent transactions of tracked wallets for a chain and wallet type, newest first, each with trader profile and position after the trade. Optionally filter to a single token with mint, which adds a token block. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Wallet category kol, smart or whale. Availability per chain. Solana has kol, smart, whale. BNB, Base and Robinhood Chain have kol, smart. ETH has kol.

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: Optional token mint to filter the feed to a single token. Adds a token block.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of transactions to return.

token.description: Only present when mint is passed. Token block with mint, token_name, blockchain, currency, token_supply, token_decimals.

get.description: Transactions of tracked wallets within a recent time window, newest first. The window is seconds plus minutes, summed; the maximum is 60 minutes, larger requests are capped and a warning is added. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Wallet category kol, smart or whale.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Seconds to look back. Combined with minutes.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: Minutes to look back. Combined with seconds. Maximum total window is 60 minutes.

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: Optional token mint to filter the window to a single token. Adds a token block.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of transactions to return.

time_window_seconds.description: The effective window in seconds, after capping.

count.description: Number of transactions in the window.

token.description: Only present when mint is passed. Token block with mint, token_name, blockchain, currency, token_supply, token_decimals.

transactions.description: Same transaction shape as the Latest endpoint.

warnings.description: Present only if the requested window exceeded the 60 minute maximum and was capped.

get.description: Count how many transactions tracked wallets made within a time window (seconds, minutes and hours summed, up to 24 hours), optionally for a single token. Without a window you get the full available window. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Wallet category kol, smart or whale.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Seconds to look back. Combined with minutes and hours.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: Minutes to look back.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Hours to look back. Maximum total window is 24 hours.

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: Optional token mint to count only that token transactions.

count.description: Number of transactions in the window.

time_window_seconds.description: The effective window in seconds, after capping.

mint.description: Present only when a mint filter was passed.

warnings.description: Present only if the requested window exceeded the 24 hour maximum and was capped.

get.description: Total trading volume of tracked wallets within a time window (seconds, minutes and hours summed, up to 24 hours), in native currency and USD, optionally for a single token. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Wallet category kol, smart or whale.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Seconds to look back. Combined with minutes and hours.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: Minutes to look back.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Hours to look back. Maximum total window is 24 hours.

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: Optional token mint to measure only that token volume.

volume.description: Total traded volume in the window (native currency).

volume_usd.description: Total traded volume in USD, or null if no USD value could be derived.

time_window_seconds.description: The effective window in seconds, after capping.

mint.description: Present only when a mint filter was passed.

warnings.description: Present only if the requested window exceeded the 24 hour maximum and was capped.

get.description: Live trade signals derived from tracked wallet activity in a recent window. cluster mode surfaces tokens where several tracked wallets are buying at once; entry and exit return individual buy and sell events in the transactions feed shape (with holdings_after). The documented response schema describes cluster mode. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Wallet category kol, smart or whale.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Signal mode. One of cluster, entry, exit.

parameters.name: min_wallets
parameters.description: cluster mode. Minimum number of wallets buying the same token to form a cluster.

parameters.name: min_value
parameters.description: Minimum trade value to consider (native).

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Time window in hours to look back for signals.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of signals to return.

filters.description: The applied filters (min_win_rate, include_wallets, exclude_wallets, min_token_age_hours, max_token_age_hours).

signals.description: Signals. Item shape shown is for cluster mode.

token.description: Token block (mint, token_name, blockchain, currency, token_supply, token_decimals).

signal_strength.description: strong or medium, based on how many wallets qualified.

gate.description: Whether the gate was met and the thresholds used.

token_stats.description: Whole history token stats (total_buyers, still_holding_count, active_count, total_volume, total_volume_usd, net_flow, holders_by_type, first_entry_time).

win_rate.description: Lifetime win rate, only when min_win_rate was requested, otherwise null.

is_active.description: True when bag_pct is above 1 percent.

get.description: Historical cluster signals that would have fired on past days, for backtesting a cluster strategy. Each entry carries the token, how many wallets clustered, how much they invested, the day and triggered_at. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Wallet category kol, smart or whale.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: How many past days to include.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of signals to return.

days.description: The number of past days included.

total_invested_usd.description: Total invested in USD, or null if no price was available.

triggered_at.description: When the first buy of the cluster happened.

day.description: The day this signal belongs to.

would_have_fired.description: Whether the signal would have fired under the thresholds.

get.description: Aggregate analytics over tracked wallets for a period. All modes share the wrapper (mode, blockchain, type, period, currency); most_traded and top_performers put items in a data array, volume_trend returns time bucketed volume points in the data array, and win_rate returns summary fields directly in the wrapper. Costs 10 credits per request.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Chain. One of solana, bnb, base, eth.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Wallet category kol, smart or whale.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Analytics view. One of most_traded, top_performers, win_rate, volume_trend.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Aggregation window, one of 6h, 1d, 7d or 30d.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, for list modes.

data.description: Present for most_traded, top_performers and volume_trend. most_traded items carry rank, mint, token_name, wallet_count, total_volume, total_buy, total_sell, net_flow, buying_pressure, currency, first_buy_at. top_performers items carry profile and period_stats. volume_trend items are time bucketed volume points.

wallets_with_trades.description: win_rate mode. Wallets that traded in the period.

win_rate_percentage.description: win_rate mode. Win rate as a percentage.

ApiKeyQuery.name: api_key
ApiKeyQuery.description: Your API key as the api_key query parameter.

BearerAuth.description: Your API key as an Authorization Bearer header.

BadRequest.description: Bad request. Code missing_parameter (a required parameter is missing) or invalid_parameter (a parameter is missing or has an invalid value, for example a chain and wallet type combination that does not exist such as eth with whale).

Forbidden.description: Code forbidden. API key invalid or credits exhausted.

NotFound.description: Code not_found. The wallet is not tracked by CabalSpy.

RateLimited.description: Code rate_limited. Rate limit exceeded (the plan's requests-per-second limit), wait and retry.

Meta.description: Request metadata returned with every response.

Pagination.description: Standard pagination object. Depending on the endpoint it appears inside data or next to data at the top level of the response.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page (null means end).

type.description: Wallet type kol, smart or whale.

market_cap.description: Current market cap in native currency. Solana only, null otherwise.

market_cap_usd.description: Current market cap in USD. Solana only, null otherwise.

market_cap_currency.description: Currency of the market cap value (SOL), or null.

price.description: Current token price in native currency. Solana only.

price_usd.description: Current token price in USD. Solana only.

sol_price_usd.description: SOL price in USD used for USD conversions. Solana only.

HoldingsAfter.description: Holder position right after a trade.

Position.description: Live position of a wallet in a token.

bag_pct.description: Percent of peak holding still held.

unrealized_pnl_sol.description: Unrealized PnL on the remaining bag (native). Solana only. Frozen to 0 once fully sold.

unrealized_pnl_usd.description: Unrealized PnL in USD. Solana only.

remaining_sol.description: Current value of the remaining bag (native). Solana only.

remaining_usd.description: Current value of the remaining bag in USD. Solana only.

entry_market_cap.description: Market cap in SOL when the wallet first bought, frozen. Solana only, null for older positions.

entry_market_cap_usd.description: Entry market cap in USD, frozen at buy time. Solana only, null for older positions.

FeedTransaction.description: A single buy or sell of a tracked wallet.

token_amount.description: Number of tokens in the trade.

above_500.description: Positions with more than 500 percent gain.

Error.description: Error response. The documentation specifies the HTTP status and an error code (missing_parameter, invalid_parameter, unauthorized, forbidden, not_found, rate_limited) but not the exact body layout, so no fields are asserted here.
